_why: Commits and digests this package legitimately DISCUSSES but was not produced from. head-consistency.py refuses any other SHA in a claim-bearing member, so a stale head from a superseded round cannot appear silently. Every entry here is a deliberate mention with its reason. The head, the parent and the commits between them are not listed: they are what this package IS, and they are derived rather than named. NO COMMIT HERE IS DESCRIBED AS A SET-ASIDE COHORT, because this lane set none aside; the previous package named one that had no matching ledger row, and the completeness checker now refuses that.

commits.0d11766ec232b2b4e46a7d1b0ada56ef22370004: The V14 independent review this lane answers, on review/catena-wave-1-e1-corrections-v14-independent. It answered CHANGES REQUIRED at the parent. This is the first entry of its kind since V13, whose review was never published; every lane from V5 to V12 could name its review by commit and V14 could not.
commits.f74f8f4d4de44e21afdbef1fc4e9589a9898e986: The V14 evidence commit on evidence/catena-e1-corrections-v14-handoff, carrying the immutable handoff of the head this lane corrects. Named so the chain from the reviewed package to this correction is followable without the reviewer reconstructing it.
commits.e4085889fc1b3d2e6721b21166394fe5ea2dea9b: Current origin/main at the time of this lane, recorded so a reviewer can see this candidate is not integrated with it and does not overlap it on any Catena path.
commits.728c3e3b3d0d6e899f0da33e06a08a116375896f: The V12 independent review, on review/catena-wave-1-e1-corrections-v12-independent. Named where this lane cites a decision that review made and the reviews after it left standing — the page-wide fail-closed contamination policy accepted as a design — and named again as one of the published review commits that make the V13 gap V13's alone. Not the review this lane answers.
commits.414f303954d79b966f4d7f0ad6814376c0014fb7: Not a commit: the V14 package's ZIP SHA-256, at 1,366,960 bytes over 69 members, quoted so the artifact this lane supersedes is identified by its bytes rather than by its name alone.
commits.733e84909e0e8049629187352d3800be320e469d: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of src/web/browser/catena/catena.css, byte-identical at both endpoints, quoted where this package claims no stylesheet changed.
commits.7779d1f19ca175fd315cd7164f5347cc3c08d68b: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of src/web/browser/catena/index.html, byte-identical at both endpoints, quoted where this package claims no markup changed.
commits.64683c0b8bb9624278cb136e8e8cbcbd4875bff5: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of the FIRST attempt ledger this lane retired, 2,501 bytes over five rows, quoted so a reviewer handed that file can tell whether it is the one PROVENANCE.md and LIMITATIONS.md describe. It is retired, not set aside: it has no terminal row, it recorded three parent steps that were re-run from the beginning in the cohort this package ships, and no figure in this package comes from it.
commits.5b0c380cf7fab7b507dfedd6bdc0a6ade71cea38: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of the SECOND attempt ledger this lane retired, 45,619 bytes over eighty rows, quoted for the same reason. It carried both batteries and five package attempts, four discarded and one that reached a sealed terminal row, and was retired when its own anti-backdating audit refused a package timestamp the operator had chosen an hour before the attempts it named. No archive was produced by any attempt in it and no figure in this package comes from it.
